none: PAS CAM-EE1A57: Roman Coin : Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [FEL TEMP REPARATIO] ; D/ [D N CONSTAN-TIVS P F AVG]

A Roman copper alloy copy of a nummus of Constantius II dating to AD355 - AD361 (Reece Period 18). Reverse legend reads [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Reverse shows soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Obverse legend reads [D N CONSTAN-TIVS P F AVG]. Obverse shows diademed bust right. Die axis is 6 o'clock, diameter is 17.49mm, thickness is 1.73mm and weight is 2.2g
